scenarios.exact_text:
One corner each.
One picture of home.
scenarios.physical_action: Waist-up Aachu on the left and Zuv on the right each use one clearly visible active hand to grip opposite vertical sides of one plain, unlettered wooden picture frame with a blank warm-ivory center; fingers visibly wrap the same connected frame, each forearm is clearly attached, and their other arms remain outside the crop.
scenarios.relationship_state: both choosing the same picture of home

scenarios.exact_text:
I sealed what we had.
You opened where we'd go.
scenarios.physical_action: Aachu kneels beside one plain, unprinted moving box and presses blank brown paper tape along its seam while looking at the seam; Zuv stands behind her holding one brass key and looking toward an open doorway, with clearly different actions, gaze targets, and posture.
scenarios.relationship_state: closing one chapter while opening the next together

scenarios.risk: occlusion, doorway depth, spatial topology, and multiline exact text
scenarios.exact_text:
The doorway was too narrow.

So we stopped pushing
and changed the angle.
scenarios.physical_action: One continuous rolled jute rug is halfway through a narrow doorway: Aachu is visible in the near room crouching and pulling the front end downward while Zuv is visible beyond the threshold pushing the far end at waist height; the door jamb occludes only a short middle band of the rug and neither body intersects the wall.
scenarios.relationship_state: repairing a shared approach instead of pushing harder
